You can feel it wiggling when you strap it to your back...|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 12 |durability = 8 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = Returns to Link }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lizalfos Arm}} Lizalfos Arms are the severed arms of [[Stalizalfos]], and they can only be acquired by defeating them. When thrown, they will act as [[Boomerang]]s, and they will eventually loop back around to return to [[Link]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 349}} They continue to move and struggle, even after being disconnected, and they are very brittle. Being made of bone, Lizalfos Arms will float if they are dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]].
